_comment: Cards that exist only for the targeted-players test (tests/unit/targets/test_targeted_players.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_coppercoats` is Call the Coppercoats: any number of target opponents, and X counts the creatures THOSE opponents control. `t_loose_coppercoats` is the counterfactual spelled with `controller: "opponent"`, which counts every opponent's creatures whoever was targeted.

cards.name: Test Coppercoats
cards.oracle_text:
Strive — This spell costs {1}{W} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Choose any number of target opponents. Create X 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens, where X is the number of creatures those opponents control.

cards.name: Test Loose Coppercoats
cards.oracle_text: Choose any number of target opponents. Create X 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens, where X is the number of creatures your opponents control.
